crosh: implement cras command Adds cras command to set runtime flag for Bluetooth HFP wideband speech. The purpose of this command is to allow dogfooder to try out wideband speech audio with bluetooth headset before we fully launch it. Example to the work flow: (1) In crosh, execute 'cras enable wbs'. All subsequent Bluetooth headset connection will be configured for WBS, if controller and peripheral both support it. (2) In crosh, execute 'cras disable wbs'. All subsequent Bluetooth headset connection will be configured NOT to use WBS. These had been in portage-stable thus far, but dev-libs/glib has strictly versioned dependencies which result in the packages having to be upreved in lockstep. Promote video.Play(H264|VP8|VP9) tests to critical. video.Play(H264|VP8|VP9) are important end-to-end tests to make sure Chrome can play various video formats (currently H264, VP8, VP9). They are recently all green except a regression on board betty: https://tastboard.corp.google.com/test/video.PlayH264 https://tastboard.corp.google.com/test/video.PlayVP8 https://tastboard.corp.google.com/test/video.PlayVP9 For board betty, it is a known issue crbug.com/983913 that betty VM recently upreved kernel version from 4.14 to 4.19. Knowning that uprev kernel breaks various media/video test, kernel on amd64-generic is reverted back to 4.14 (CL:1703116). As long as betty passes video.Play(H264|VP8|VP9) again, they are eligible to promote to Tast-CQ.
